title: Prove the SL2(F3) five-call minimum with arbitrary dirty workspace
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof: the exact five-call minimum for `diag([i],[w],[w^-1 i w],1,...,1)` over `F2[SL2(F3)]` survives every finite number of restored dirty roles and arbitrary free constant binary mixing.

```text
#2010: three roles
#4083: four roles, two-or-more dirty roles left open
this proof: every finite r >= 3
           at least 2 quaternion calls + 3 order-three calls = 5
```

This answers Open next question 1 in Wentao Li / VictorLiwentao's #4083. Cinna Davis #2010 retains the endpoint, alphabet and direct word. Sagar Thakrar #4032 retains the twisted radical-rank method and semidirect-product extension question, with Cinna Davis #2116/#2047/#2248 and the retained register-model lineage credited in the package. The new step is an all-role first-order obstruction and the rigidity of at most two order-three quotient calls. No predecessor census is replayed.

## Evidence

Before: the published #4083 scope establishes one dirty role and explicitly leaves two or more open. After: `PROOF.md` forces two quaternion-label calls by first-order rank and three order-three calls by binary projector rigidity. The inherited coordinate word attains five with every additional dirty role restored.

On CPython 3.12.15, both registered warning-strict checks pass normally and under `-O`. Direct command times were 0.63 and 0.67 seconds, below their 60-second timeouts. The verifier enumerates 576 cocycle pairs, 308 one-call and 60,880 two-call quotient words, 312 deterministic sampled full-algebra words, 384 regular-action basis inputs and eleven named controls. The samples corroborate the separately written universal proof; they do not exhaust arbitrary role counts.

Generated stdout receipts bind all six package files. Metadata/source pins, committed-byte/source-history preflight at `fa2f4bc819a9e895eee624ea53b551eb9e1a3216`, official export/integrity, and an optimized Git-free exported replay pass. All seven exported files, including the export manifest, remain byte-identical after replay.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -B research/sl2f3-all-dirty-minimum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -O -B research/sl2f3-all-dirty-minimum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sl2f3-all-dirty-minimum
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/sl2f3-all-dirty-minimum --check-source-history
```

Expected marker: `PASS_SL2F3_ALL_DIRTY_MINIMUM minimum=5 i_floor=2 w_floor=3`. The registered manifest uses `{python}` so another CPython 3.12 location is supported. All external source rows are historical provenance; no predecessor executable or live input is needed.

## Limitations

The theorem requires binary rank-one idempotent role maps, the four stated paid labels, arbitrary inputs and complete dirty restoration. It does not cover clean-only or partly restored helpers, different targets, enlarged coefficient fields, physical native implementations or supplier admission. The first-order map kills the central element -1 and cannot certify pure central defects. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Native, precision/tape, outer-theorem and proof-kernel checks were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Is there a fully priced native realization of this alphabet for a changed endpoint that saves paid work? Start with one pinned arbitrary-input `D_N(i)` or `D_N(w)` program, including source access, address movement, hosting and restoration. The missing implementation and complete producer/consumer invoice are the blockers. Further dirty-role censuses for this fixed target cannot improve its five-call bill.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this SL2(F3) endpoint was found in the live SL2(F3) and tetrahedral searches at 23:12 UTC. The exact-object predecessors #2010 and #4083 and the methodological predecessor #4032 are merged. Search coverage does not certify novelty.
